research_question: Can the source-native 2003 Sumatera Barat construction qualification classes B/M1/M2/K1/K2/K3 be aggregated into Kecil/Menengah/Besar and treated as semantically comparable with the legacy BPS variable-216 labels for 2005?

official_bps_2003_source.title: Statistik Konstruksi 2004
official_bps_2003_source.table_title: JUMLAH PERUSAHAAN KONSTRUKSI MENURUT KUALIFIKASI PER KABUPATEN TAHUN 2003
official_bps_2003_source.evidence_role: Direct BPS evidence that the 2003 Sumatera Barat qualification table is published in six detailed classes plus total.

arithmetic_three_group_candidate_2003.interpretation: These values are deterministic arithmetic summaries of the source-native 2003 classes only. They are not authorized as BPS-defined 2003 aggregate categories and are not authorized for comparison with 2005 variable-216 Kecil/Menengah/Besar until a period-specific construct mapping is recovered.

semantic_audit.reason_for_fail_closed: Matching human-readable notions of small, medium, and large are insufficient to prove statistical construct equivalence across the 2003 detailed qualification table and the 2005 legacy variable-216 aggregate labels. The variable-216 source note itself records that construction-company classification regulations changed multiple times, reinforcing the need for period-specific evidence.

preferred: Official BPS Statistik Konstruksi 2005 publication 05230.0607 with the relevant qualification table and definitions.
Official BPS Profil Perusahaan Konstruksi di Luar Pulau Jawa 2005 publication 05230.0610 with Sumatera Barat qualification values and definitions.
Contemporaneous 2005 BPS or LPJK documentation explicitly stating how Kecil/Menengah/Besar correspond to B/M1/M2/K1/K2/K3 for the series used by variable 216.
forbidden: Promoting the arithmetic 2003 three-group candidate to a source-native BPS aggregate without definition evidence.
Assuming Kecil=K1+K2+K3, Menengah=M1+M2, and Besar=B for 2005 solely because the labels appear intuitively compatible.
Inferring missing 2005 component values from the confirmed total 2435.
Using later 2016-2025 CSA category behavior as a proxy for 2005.
Calculating a pre/post composition delta before the 2005 component values and category semantics are both recovered.
